episodeTitle.en: The art of influence: The single most important skill left that AI can’t replace | Jessica Fain
episodeTitle.zh: 影响力的艺术：AI无法替代的关键技能 | 杰西卡·费恩（Jessica Fain）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jessica Fain is a product leader at Webflow and former Chief of Staff to the CPO at Slack, where she worked alongside April Underwood and many past podcast guests including Stewart Butterfield, Annie Pearl, Tamar Yehoshua, and Noah Weiss. She’s spent her career learning how executives actually make decisions—and why most people completely misunderstand the process. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰西卡·费恩（Jessica Fain）是Webflow的产品负责人，曾任Slack首席产品官的幕僚长。她与安普尔·安德伍德（April Underwood）及多位往期播客嘉宾（包括斯图尔特·巴特菲尔德（Stewart Butterfield）、安妮·珀尔（Annie Pearl）、塔玛·耶霍舒亚（Tamar Yehoshua）和诺亚·韦斯（Noah Weiss））共事。她职业生涯致力于研究高管决策机制，并揭示多数人对此的误解。*我们讨论了：*

title.en: The art of influence: The single most important skill left that AI can’t replace | Jessica Fain
title.zh: 影响力的艺术：AI无法替代的关键技能 | 杰西卡·费恩（Jessica Fain）

summary.en: Jessica argues that when PMs talk to executives they inexplicably drop the curiosity and empathy they use with users—yet influence is the highest-leverage skill after AI. She explains how executives actually make decisions (picture a strobe light of urgent demands), why you must connect your pitch to their goals and metrics, how asking 'what is the board pushing you on?' builds trust, and why killing and deprioritizing work signals senior leadership. The episode gets tactically deep on how to change minds and the mistakes people make trying to influence up.
summary.zh: Jessica 指出，PM 一和 executives 谈话，就会莫名其妙地丢掉面对用户时的好奇心与同理心——然而影响力是仅次于 AI 的、杠杆率最高的技能。她解释了高管究竟如何做决策（想象一盏不断闪烁的紧急事项信号灯）、为何你必须把自己的提案与他们的目标和指标相连、问“董事会在逼你做什么？”如何建立信任，以及为何砍掉和降优先级的工作反而彰显资深领导力。这期节目就“如何改变他人想法”以及向上管理时常犯的错误给出了极具战术深度的内容。
